<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="tr">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8"/>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1.0"/>
<link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="data:image/png;base64,"/>
<title>Batarya Kapasite Hesaplama — Bozankaya</title>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@tabler/icons-webfont@3.19.0/dist/tabler-icons.min.css"/>
<style>
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
:root{
  --bg:#eef0f4;--surface:#fff;--surface2:#f4f5f7;
  --border:rgba(0,0,0,0.08);--border-md:rgba(0,0,0,0.16);
  --text:#15181d;--text2:#50555f;--text3:#8e949f;
  --r-md:10px;--r-lg:14px;--r-xl:18px;
  --green:#16a34a;--green-bg:#dcfce7;--green-text:#15803d;--green-bd:#bbf7d0;
  --yellow:#d97706;--yellow-bg:#fef3c7;--yellow-text:#b45309;--yellow-bd:#fde68a;
  --red:#dc2626;--red-bg:#fee2e2;--red-text:#b91c1c;--red-bd:#fecaca;
  --blue:#2563eb;--blue-bg:#eff6ff;--blue-text:#1d4ed8;--blue-bd:#bfdbfe;
  --brand:#810d11;--brand-dark:#5c090c;--brand-light:#a81217;
  --shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.07),0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
}
body{font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);min-height:100vh;}

/* ── HEADER ── */
.app-header{background:linear-gradient(120deg,var(--brand-dark) 0%,var(--brand) 60%,var(--brand-light) 100%);padding:0 2rem;}
.header-inner{max-width:1400px;margin:0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1.5rem;height:70px;}
.header-logo{flex-shrink:0;display:flex;align-items:center;}
.header-sep{width:1px;height:36px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.25);flex-shrink:0;}
.header-text{flex:1;}
.header-text .label{font-size:10px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:0.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.5);margin-bottom:2px;}
.header-text h1{font-size:17px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;line-height:1.2;}
.header-meta{margin-left:auto;display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;}


/* ── MAIN LAYOUT ── */
.page{max-width:1400px;margin:0 auto;padding:1.5rem 1.5rem 3rem;display:grid;grid-template-columns:380px 1fr;gap:1.25rem;align-items:start;}
@media(max-width:900px){.page{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}

/* ── CARD ── */
.card{background:var(--surface);border-radius:var(--r-xl);box-shadow:var(--shadow);border:0.5px solid var(--border);overflow:hidden;}
.card-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:1rem 1.25rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--surface2);}
.card-head-icon{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:8px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;}
.card-head-icon.blue{background:var(--blue-bg);} .card-head-icon.blue i{color:var(--blue);}
.card-head-icon.green{background:var(--green-bg);} .card-head-icon.green i{color:var(--green);}
.card-head-icon.brand{background:rgba(129,13,17,0.1);} .card-head-icon.brand i{color:var(--brand);}
.card-head-icon i{font-size:17px;}
.card-head h2{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text);}
.card-head p{font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);margin-top:1px;}
.card-body{padding:1.25rem;}

/* ── FIELD GROUPS ── */
.fg-title{font-size:10px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.07em;color:var(--text3);margin:1rem 0 0.6rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;}
.fg-title::after{content:'';flex:1;height:1px;background:var(--border);}
.fg-title:first-child{margin-top:0;}
.field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;margin-bottom:10px;}
.field label{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text2);}
.field .hint{font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);}
.field select,.field input{width:100%;padding:8px 11px;font-size:13px;border:1.5px solid var(--border-md);border-radius:var(--r-md);background:var(--surface2);color:var(--text);outline:none;transition:border-color .15s,box-shadow .15s;-webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;}
.field select:focus,.field input:focus{border-color:var(--brand);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(129,13,17,0.1);background:#fff;}
.grid2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;}
.sarj-display{padding:8px 11px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;background:var(--blue-bg);border:1.5px solid var(--blue-bd);border-radius:var(--r-md);color:var(--blue-text);}

/* ── METRICS ── */
.metrics-2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;margin-bottom:10px;}
.metrics-3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:8px;margin-bottom:10px;}
.metrics-4{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:8px;margin-bottom:10px;}
.metric{border-radius:var(--r-md);padding:12px 14px;border:1.5px solid transparent;}
.metric.neu{background:var(--surface2);border-color:var(--border);}
.metric.grn{background:var(--green-bg);border-color:var(--green-bd);}
.metric.red{background:var(--red-bg);border-color:var(--red-bd);}
.metric.yel{background:var(--yellow-bg);border-color:var(--yellow-bd);}
.metric.blu{background:var(--blue-bg);border-color:var(--blue-bd);}
.metric.brd{background:rgba(129,13,17,0.07);border-color:rgba(129,13,17,0.2);}
.mlabel{font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text3);margin-bottom:5px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;}
.mlabel i{font-size:12px;}
.metric.grn .mlabel{color:var(--green-text);}
.metric.red .mlabel{color:var(--red-text);}
.metric.yel .mlabel{color:var(--yellow-text);}
.metric.blu .mlabel{color:var(--blue-text);}
.metric.brd .mlabel{color:var(--brand);}
.mval{font-size:20px;font-weight:800;line-height:1;color:var(--text);}
.munit{font-size:12px;font-weight:400;color:var(--text2);margin-left:2px;}
.metric.grn .mval{color:var(--green);}
.metric.red .mval{color:var(--red);}
.metric.yel .mval{color:var(--yellow);}
.metric.blu .mval{color:var(--blue);}
.metric.brd .mval{color:var(--brand);}
.msub{font-size:10px;color:var(--text3);margin-top:4px;line-height:1.3;}

/* ── DIVIDER ── */
.div{border:none;border-top:1px solid var(--border);margin:1rem 0;}

/* ── SECTION TITLE ── */
.sec-title{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text);margin:0 0 0.75rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;}
.sec-title i{font-size:15px;color:var(--brand);}

/* ── PASSENGER STATUS ── */
.ps-box{border-radius:var(--r-md);padding:.875rem 1rem;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px;margin-bottom:10px;border:1.5px solid;}
.ps-box.ok{background:var(--green-bg);border-color:var(--green-bd);}
.ps-box.fail{background:var(--red-bg);border-color:var(--red-bd);}
.ps-box i{font-size:22px;flex-shrink:0;margin-top:1px;}
.ps-box.ok i{color:var(--green);}
.ps-box.fail i{color:var(--red);}
.ps-title{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;}
.ps-box.ok .ps-title{color:var(--green);}
.ps-box.fail .ps-title{color:var(--red);}
.ps-desc{font-size:11px;color:var(--text2);margin-top:2px;line-height:1.4;}

/* ── BADGE ── */
.badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:3px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:99px;border:1px solid;}
.badge-grn{background:var(--green-bg);color:var(--green-text);border-color:var(--green-bd);}
.badge-red{background:var(--red-bg);color:var(--red-text);border-color:var(--red-bd);}

/* ── TABLE ── */
.tbl-wrap{overflow-x:auto;border-radius:var(--r-md);border:1px solid var(--border);}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:12px;}
thead{background:var(--surface2);}
th{text-align:left;padding:9px 11px;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text3);white-space:nowrap;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);}
td{padding:8px 11px;border-bottom:0.5px solid var(--border);color:var(--text);vertical-align:middle;}
tr:last-child td{border-bottom:none;}
tr.r-first td{background:#f0f4ff;font-weight:700;}
tr.r-warn td{background:#fffbf0;}
tr.r-danger td{background:#fff5f5;}

footer{text-align:center;font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);padding:1.5rem 1rem;border-top:1px solid var(--border);max-width:1400px;margin:0 auto;}

/* ── PRINT BUTTON ── */
.print-btn{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;margin-left:auto;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.15);border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3);border-radius:8px;padding:7px 16px;color:#fff;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s;}
.print-btn:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,0.25);}
.print-btn i{font-size:16px;}

@media print{
  .print-btn,.header-sep ~ .print-btn{display:none!important;}
  body{background:#fff!important;padding:0;}
  .app-header{background:#810d11!important;-webkit-print-color-adjust:exact;print-color-adjust:exact;}
  .page{display:block!important;padding:0.5rem!important;}
  .card{box-shadow:none!important;border:1px solid #ddd!important;margin-bottom:0.75rem!important;break-inside:avoid;}
  .card:first-child{position:relative!important;}
  footer{font-size:10px;}
}
</style>
</head>

      <div class="label">Bozankaya Raylı Sistemler A.Ş.</div>
      <h1>Batarya Kapasite Hesaplama</h1>

<!-- MAIN -->
<div class="page">

  <!-- SOL: GİRDİLER -->
  <div class="card" style="position:sticky;top:1rem;">
    <div class="card-head">
      <div class="card-head-icon blue"><i class="ti ti-adjustments-horizontal"></i></div>
      <div><h2>Girdi Parametreleri</h2><p>Seçmeli ve manuel girilecek alanlar</p></div>
    </div>
    <div class="card-body">

      <div class="fg-title"><i class="ti ti-list-check"></i> Seçmeli Alanlar</div>
      <div class="field">
        <label>Araç Tipi</label>
        <select id="arac">
          <option value="E-BUS 10m">E-BUS 10m</option>
          <option value="E-BUS 12m" selected>E-BUS 12m</option>
          <option value="E-BUS 18m">E-BUS 18m</option>
          <option value="T-BUS 12m">T-BUS 12m</option>
          <option value="T-BUS 18m">T-BUS 18m</option>
          <option value="T-BUS 24m">T-BUS 24m</option>
          <option value="E-BUS 12m (E-SORT)">E-BUS 12m (E-SORT)</option>
        </select>
      </div>
      <div class="field">
        <label>Batarya Modeli</label>
        <select id="batarya">
          <option value="ZEN77">Forsee ZEN77+ (NMC) — 76.6 kWh</option>
          <option value="ZEN55">Forsee ZEN55 (LFP) — 55 kWh</option>
          <option value="ZEN36">Forsee ZEN36 (LFP) — 36 kWh</option>
          <option value="ZEN36N">Forsee ZEN36 Narrow (LFP) — 36 kWh</option>
          <option value="ZEN79">Forsee ZEN79+ (NMC) — 79 kWh</option>
          <option value="PULSE15">Forsee Pulse 15 (LTO) — 14.6 kWh</option>
          <option value="PULSE26">Forsee Pulse 26 (LTO) — 26 kWh</option>
          <option value="BMZ168">BMZ 168S MAGNUS+ — 72.4 kWh</option>
        </select>
      </div>
      <div class="field">
        <label>Paket Sayısı</label>
        <select id="paket"></select>
        <div class="hint" id="paket-hint"></div>
      </div>

      <div class="fg-title"><i class="ti ti-pencil"></i> Manuel Girilecek Alanlar</div>
      <div class="grid2">
        <div class="field">
          <label>Araç Tüketimi (kWh/km)</label>
          <input type="number" id="tuketim" value="1.20" min="0.3" max="5" step="0.01"/>
          <div class="hint">10m≈1.1 · 12m≈1.2 · 18m≈2.0</div>
        </div>
        <div class="field">
          <label>Günlük Menzil Hedefi (km)</label>
          <input type="number" id="gunluk_menzil" value="300" min="10" max="800"/>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="grid2">
        <div class="field">
          <label>Rezerve Oranı (%)</label>
          <input type="number" id="rezerve" value="15" min="0" max="30"/>
          <div class="hint">DoD = 100% − Rezerve</div>
        </div>
        <div class="field">
          <label>Yıllık Kapasite Kaybı (%)</label>
          <input type="number" id="yillik_kayip" value="2" min="0" max="5" step="0.5"/>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="grid2">
        <div class="field">
          <label>Yıllık Ortalama km <span style="color:var(--text3);font-size:10px;">(0 = günlük bazlı)</span></label>
          <input type="number" id="yillik_km" value="60000" min="0" max="200000" step="1000"/>
        </div>
        <div class="field">
          <label>Yolcu Sayısı (kişi)</label>
          <input type="number" id="yolcu_sayisi" value="79" min="1" max="200"/>
          <div class="hint">68 kg/kişi ile hesaplanır</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="fg-title"><i class="ti ti-plug"></i> Şarj Parametreleri</div>
      <div class="grid2">
        <div class="field">
          <label>Şarj Gücü (kW)</label>
          <input type="number" id="sarj_gucu" value="120" min="20" max="600"/>
        </div>
        <div class="field">
          <label>Şarj Süresi</label>
          <div class="sarj-display" id="sarj-sure-display">— sa</div>
          <div class="hint" id="sarj-uygun-hint"></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- SAĞ: SONUÇLAR -->
  <div>

    <!-- Ana metrikler -->
    <div class="card" style="margin-bottom:1.25rem;">
      <div class="card-head">
        <div class="card-head-icon green"><i class="ti ti-chart-bar"></i></div>
        <div><h2>Kapasite &amp; Menzil</h2><p>Temel performans göstergeleri</p></div>
      </div>
      <div class="card-body">
        <div class="metrics-3" id="ana-metrikler"></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Yolcu -->
    <div class="card" style="margin-bottom:1.25rem;">
      <div class="card-head">
        <div class="card-head-icon brand"><i class="ti ti-users"></i></div>
        <div><h2>Yolcu Kapasitesi — Homolagasyon</h2><p>Ağırlık bazlı yolcu analizi</p></div>
      </div>
      <div class="card-body">
        <div id="yolcu-status"></div>
        <div class="metrics-4" id="yolcu-metrikler"></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Yıllık tablo -->
    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-head">
        <div class="card-head-icon blue"><i class="ti ti-calendar-stats"></i></div>
        <div><h2>Yıllara Göre Menzil ve Kapasite</h2><p>12 yıllık projeksiyon — kapasite kaybı ve cycle takibi</p></div>
      </div>
      <div class="card-body">
        <div class="tbl-wrap">
          <table>
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th>Yıl</th>
                <th>Yıllık Kayıp</th>
                <th>Günlük Menzil (km)</th>
                <th>Kull. Kapasite (kWh)</th>
                <th>Kümülatif Cycle</th>
                <th>Durum</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody id="yil-tbody"></tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

  </div>
</div>

<footer>Hesaplamaların tamamı Emrullah GÜLERYÜZ tarafından gerçekleştirilmiştir. İzinsiz paylaşılması, çoğaltılması veya üçüncü kişilerle kullanılması yasaktır. Tüm hakları saklıdır.</footer>

<script>
const ARACLAR={
  "E-BUS 10m":{homog:19000,bosAgirlik:10500},
  "E-BUS 12m":{homog:19000,bosAgirlik:11335},
  "E-BUS 18m":{homog:29000,bosAgirlik:17676},
  "T-BUS 12m":{homog:19000,bosAgirlik:11335},
  "T-BUS 18m":{homog:29000,bosAgirlik:17676},
  "T-BUS 24m":{homog:38000,bosAgirlik:24000},
  "E-BUS 12m (E-SORT)":{homog:19000,bosAgirlik:10000}
};
const BATARYALAR={
  "ZEN77":{kimya:"NMC",kapasite:76.6,agirlik:433,cycle:5000,maliyet:16852,maxSarj:390},
  "ZEN55":{kimya:"LFP",kapasite:55,agirlik:370,cycle:6000,maliyet:7645,maxSarj:200},
  "ZEN36":{kimya:"LFP",kapasite:36,agirlik:247,cycle:6000,maliyet:5004,maxSarj:150},
  "ZEN36N":{kimya:"LFP",kapasite:36,agirlik:256,cycle:6000,maliyet:5004,maxSarj:150},
  "ZEN79":{kimya:"NMC",kapasite:79,agirlik:446,cycle:5000,maliyet:17424,maxSarj:390},
  "PULSE15":{kimya:"LTO",kapasite:14.6,agirlik:260,cycle:20000,maliyet:18750,maxSarj:214},
  "PULSE26":{kimya:"LTO",kapasite:26,agirlik:455,cycle:20000,maliyet:33125,maxSarj:300},
  "BMZ168":{kimya:"NMC",kapasite:72.4,agirlik:450,cycle:5000,maliyet:null,maxSarj:390}
};
const YOLCU_KG=68, EOL_ORAN=0.82;

function paketGuncelle(){
  const bat=BATARYALAR[document.getElementById("batarya").value];
  const sel=document.getElementById("paket");
  const hint=document.getElementById("paket-hint");
  const prev=parseInt(sel.value)||6;
  sel.innerHTML="";
  if(bat.kimya==="LFP"){
    [3,6,9,12].forEach(n=>{
      const o=document.createElement("option");
      o.value=n;o.textContent=n;
      if(n===(prev%3===0&&prev<=12?prev:6))o.selected=true;
      sel.appendChild(o);
    });
    hint.textContent="LFP: yalnızca 3'ün katı paket sayısı.";
  } else {
    for(let n=1;n<=15;n++){
      const o=document.createElement("option");
      o.value=n;o.textContent=n;
      if(n===Math.min(prev,15))o.selected=true;
      sel.appendChild(o);
    }
    hint.textContent="";
  }
}

function yilAdi(y){return y===0?"İlk Yıl":y+". Yıl";}

function m(cls,icon,label,val,unit,sub){
  return`<div class="metric ${cls}">
    <div class="mlabel"><i class="ti ${icon}"></i>${label}</div>
    <div class="mval">${val}<span class="munit">${unit}</span></div>
    ${sub?`<div class="msub">${sub}</div>`:""}
  </div>`;
}

function hesapla(){
  const aracKey=document.getElementById("arac").value;
  const batKey=document.getElementById("batarya").value;
  const arac=ARACLAR[aracKey], bat=BATARYALAR[batKey];
  const paket=parseInt(document.getElementById("paket").value)||6;
  const tuketim=parseFloat(document.getElementById("tuketim").value)||1.2;
  const gunlukMenzil=parseFloat(document.getElementById("gunluk_menzil").value)||300;
  const rezerve=(parseFloat(document.getElementById("rezerve").value)||15)/100;
  const kayip=(parseFloat(document.getElementById("yillik_kayip").value)||2)/100;
  const yillikKmRaw=parseFloat(document.getElementById("yillik_km").value)||0;
  const yolcuSayisi=parseInt(document.getElementById("yolcu_sayisi").value)||79;
  const sarjGucu=parseFloat(document.getElementById("sarj_gucu").value)||120;

  const DoD=1-rezerve;
  const topKap=bat.kapasite*paket;
  const kullKap0=topKap*DoD;
  const menzil0=kullKap0/tuketim;
  const topMaliyet=bat.maliyet?bat.maliyet*paket:null;
  const batAgirlik=bat.agirlik*paket;
  const sarjSureSa=kullKap0/sarjGucu;
  const sarjUygun=sarjGucu<=bat.maxSarj;
  const eolCycle=bat.cycle*EOL_ORAN;

  // ── CYCLE HESABI — 2 ihtimal
  let yillikCycle, garantiYil, cycleAciklama;
  if(yillikKmRaw>0){
    // 1. İhtimal: Yıllık km girilmiş
    const yillikKwh=yillikKmRaw*tuketim;
    yillikCycle=(yillikKwh/(topKap*DoD))*1.3;
    garantiYil=eolCycle/yillikCycle;
    cycleAciklama=`Yıllık km bazlı · ${yillikKmRaw.toLocaleString('tr-TR')} km × ${tuketim} kWh/km`;
  } else {
    // 2. İhtimal: Günlük menzil bazlı
    const gunlukKwh=gunlukMenzil*tuketim;
    const gunlukCycle=gunlukKwh/(topKap*DoD);
    yillikCycle=gunlukCycle*365*1.3;
    garantiYil=eolCycle/yillikCycle;
    cycleAciklama=`Günlük menzil bazlı · ${gunlukMenzil} km/gün × 365`;
  }

  // Homolagasyon
  const aracTamAgir=arac.bosAgirlik+batAgirlik;
  const kalanYuk=arac.homog-aracTamAgir;
  const maxYolcu=Math.floor(Math.max(0,kalanYuk)/YOLCU_KG);
  const istenenKg=yolcuSayisi*YOLCU_KG;
  const yolcuUygun=kalanYuk>=istenenKg;

  // Şarj
  document.getElementById("sarj-sure-display").textContent=`${sarjSureSa.toFixed(1)} sa (${Math.round(sarjSureSa*60)} dk)`;
  const sh=document.getElementById("sarj-uygun-hint");
  sh.textContent=sarjUygun?`✓ Uygun (maks. ${bat.maxSarj} kW)`:`⚠ Batarya maks. ${bat.maxSarj} kW!`;
  sh.style.color=sarjUygun?"var(--green)":"var(--red)";

  // Ana metrikler
  const menzilRenk=menzil0>=gunlukMenzil?"grn":"red";
  document.getElementById("ana-metrikler").innerHTML=
    m("neu","ti-battery-charging","Toplam Kapasite",topKap.toFixed(1),"kWh",`${paket} paket × ${bat.kapasite} kWh`)+
    m("neu","ti-battery-3","Kullanılabilir Kapasite",kullKap0.toFixed(1),"kWh",`DoD %${Math.round(DoD*100)} · Rezerve %${Math.round(rezerve*100)}`)+
    m(menzilRenk,"ti-road","İlk Yıl Menzil",Math.round(menzil0),"km",`Hedef: ${gunlukMenzil} km/gün`)+
    (topMaliyet?m("neu","ti-currency-euro","Toplam Maliyet",topMaliyet.toLocaleString('tr-TR'),"€",`${paket} × ${bat.maliyet?.toLocaleString('tr-TR')} €`):m("yel","ti-currency-euro","Toplam Maliyet","—","","Fiyat bilgisi mevcut değil"))+
    m("brd","ti-repeat","Cycle Ömrü Tamamlanma",garantiYil.toFixed(1),"yıl",cycleAciklama)+
    m("blu","ti-weight","Batarya Ağırlığı",batAgirlik.toLocaleString('tr-TR'),"kg",`${paket} × ${bat.agirlik} kg`);

  // Yolcu
  const ps=document.getElementById("yolcu-status");
  if(yolcuUygun){
    ps.innerHTML=`<div class="ps-box ok"><i class="ti ti-circle-check"></i><div><div class="ps-title">Yolcu Kapasitesi Uygun ✓</div><div class="ps-desc">${yolcuSayisi} yolcu (${istenenKg.toLocaleString('tr-TR')} kg) homolagasyon sınırı içinde. Kalan: ${(kalanYuk-istenenKg).toLocaleString('tr-TR')} kg</div></div></div>`;
  } else {
    ps.innerHTML=`<div class="ps-box fail"><i class="ti ti-alert-triangle"></i><div><div class="ps-title">Yolcu Kapasitesi Uygun Değil ✗</div><div class="ps-desc">${yolcuSayisi} yolcu (${istenenKg.toLocaleString('tr-TR')} kg) sınırı ${(istenenKg-kalanYuk).toLocaleString('tr-TR')} kg aşıyor. Maksimum ${maxYolcu} yolcu taşınabilir.</div></div></div>`;
  }
  document.getElementById("yolcu-metrikler").innerHTML=
    m("neu","ti-car","Araç Boş Ağırlığı",arac.bosAgirlik.toLocaleString('tr-TR'),"kg","Batarya hariç")+
    m("neu","ti-battery","Batarya Toplam Ağırlığı",batAgirlik.toLocaleString('tr-TR'),"kg",`${paket} × ${bat.agirlik} kg`)+
    m("neu","ti-flag","Homolagasyon Sınırı",arac.homog.toLocaleString('tr-TR'),"kg",aracKey.includes("18m")?"18m sınırı":"12m sınırı")+
    m(yolcuUygun?"grn":"red","ti-users","Yolcu Kapasitesi",yolcuSayisi+" / "+maxYolcu,"kişi",yolcuUygun?"İstenen uygun ✓":`Maks. ${maxYolcu} kişi`);

  // Tablo
  const tbody=document.getElementById("yil-tbody");
  tbody.innerHTML="";
  let kumCycle=0;
  for(let y=0;y<=12;y++){
    const kk=kullKap0*Math.pow(1-kayip,y);
    const mn=kk/tuketim;
    const yCycle=y===0?0:(kk/kullKap0)*yillikCycle;
    kumCycle+=yCycle;
    const eolAsil=kumCycle>=eolCycle&&y>0;
    const yeterli=mn>=gunlukMenzil;
    let badge,trClass="";
    if(eolAsil){badge=`<span class="badge badge-red"><i class="ti ti-x"></i> EoL Aşıldı</span>`;trClass="r-danger";}
    else if(!yeterli){badge=`<span class="badge badge-red"><i class="ti ti-x"></i> Uygun Değil</span>`;trClass="r-warn";}
    else{badge=`<span class="badge badge-grn"><i class="ti ti-check"></i> Uygun</span>`;}
    if(y===0)trClass="r-first";
    const tr=document.createElement("tr");
    tr.className=trClass;
    tr.innerHTML=`<td><strong>${yilAdi(y)}</strong></td><td>${y===0?"—":"%"+(kayip*100).toFixed(1)+" / yıl"}</td><td>${Math.round(mn)} km</td><td>${kk.toFixed(1)} kWh</td><td>${y===0?"—":kumCycle.toFixed(0)}</td><td>${badge}</td>`;
    tbody.appendChild(tr);
  }
}

document.getElementById("arac").addEventListener("change",hesapla);
document.getElementById("batarya").addEventListener("change",()=>{paketGuncelle();hesapla();});
document.getElementById("paket").addEventListener("change",hesapla);
document.querySelectorAll("input").forEach(el=>el.addEventListener("input",hesapla));
paketGuncelle();
hesapla();
</script>
</body>
</html>
